body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Sanyo provided a innovative massage chair under the theme of zero gravity and zero worries for those who visit its booth in LVCC during CES 2006.
It features a built-in thumb shape roller on massage chair which provides real massage feeling and a galvanic skin response technology to test the whole body pressure to release tension accordingly.
The ''HEC-DR7700K'' enables users to stay in a zero gravity positions which let their legs to stay above heart position just like astronaut in a space.
It will be available this March for estimated MSRP of $4,700.
